attention.issue: Money text parsed to float
attention.fix: truncateDecimals turns text like "12345678901234567.89" into a JS number before clipping, so very large amounts lose digits and money is handled as a float (CLAUDE.md rule). Display only, but clip number text as text (cut after the 2nd decimal) instead of Number() for strings.

attention.issue: Screen and export show different values
attention.fix: Cells show dd-mm-yyyy dates and 2 clipped decimals, but Excel export and Print still use the raw values (ISO timestamps, full decimals). Decide which the files should show; if the screen version, pass the same formatters into the export data.

attention.issue: Number columns guessed from data
attention.fix: Alignment comes from the values and the column name, not from a field type: a column with one non-number value ("N/A") stays left, and a name the ID pattern misses (or wrongly matches) is aligned wrong. Ask the backend for a type per field and switch to it.

attention.issue: Date columns found by key name
attention.fix: Any UCRF key containing "date" or "dob" is treated as a date, so a key like "updateFlag" would match too. Only 8-digit values are reformatted, so the risk is small; a fixed list of date keys would be exact.

attention.issue: Date-only text depends on time zone
attention.fix: formatDateDMY reads "2026-11-01" as UTC midnight, so a user west of UTC would see 31-10-2026. Fine for India; parse date-only text as a local date if users outside India appear.

author: Dhruv

attention.issue: Product filter fails without HRMS rights
attention.fix: In plain words: the Loan Products dropdown asks the HRMS employee screen for the user's products. A user such as a cashier has no right to that HRMS screen, so the server says 403 and the dropdown is empty. This is not about report rights: the report itself runs fine, only the product choices cannot load. Fix: ask the backend for a products dropdown that needs no HRMS right, like the branch one.

attention.issue: Build screen opens from a typed URL
attention.fix: In plain words: hiding the Build Report button stops clicks, but anyone can type ?view=build-report in the address bar and the build screen opens. Saving is then refused by the server (403), so no data is lost or leaked, the user just fills a form that cannot save. Fix: if the user has no canAdd, send them back to the report list when that URL is used.

attention.issue: Save button not tied to rights
attention.fix: In plain words: the buttons that lead into the builder check your rights, but once inside, Save is always clickable. A user who got in (for example a Duplicate before rights changed, or an old open tab) can press Save and only then be told no (403). Fix: grey out Save unless the user has canAdd for a new report or canEdit when editing.
